column1: # What the playground's built interface (ui/dist/, embedded in the binary) holds of other
# people's work, and the licence text of each: the npm packages that ship (the dependencies
# of ui/package.json, at the versions ui/package-lock.json pins) and the fonts under
# ui/public/fonts/. scripts/third-party-licences.sh writes them into THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md
# and fails when this list and those files disagree. Fields, apart by tabs: kind, name,
# version, licence, the text's file in this folder, and for a font the files it is.
